svg.text: NHE Pi 2x2 Audio: build layout (from NHE-2x2-Pi-Audio.vrt)
40 x 37 holes. Drawn from the VeroRoute layout; checked against the netlist: every net connected once the two green links are in.
Parts as placed. Faint lines: traces underneath. Dashed: where the converter boards and the Pi sit.
GPIO inner row (even pins) · red box = pin 40
GPIO edge row (odd pins) · red box = GPIO pin 39
Every line is a trace: solder bridges between pads, or tinned wire. Green: the two wire links.
• Two wire links to add (green), on the trace side, each hopping one GPIO pin: L1 J4 pin 4 to GPIO 35 (LRCK), L2 J4 pin 6 to GPIO 39 (the ADC’s ground).
• R14 stands under the top of the ADC board: lay it flat (about 3 mm tall) or move it out of the dashed area.
• Row 33 has traces below the GPIO edge row: the board edge goes past them, so the carrier overlaps the Pi by about 9 mm. Check it clears the Active Cooler.
• Pin 1 boxes are red. The GPIO edge-row box is pin 39; check the mirror: the Pi’s pin 1 (square pad on its underside) meets the right-hand end of the edge row.
